subject: Post-demo: cost sensitivity & target $/1M pricing check
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <maya@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-15T16:10:00Z
Subject: Post-demo: cost sensitivity & target $/1M pricing check

Hi Maya — great to meet earlier. Short recap and two ask items so we can prepare a tight proposal for Nimbus.

Recap from today's discovery:
- Primary use case: multi-tenant analytics summarization + ad-hoc question answering for enterprise users.
- Expected production throughput: ~50M generated tokens / month after launch; seasonal/feature bursts up to ~200M for 2-3 months.
- Latency SLO: P95 < 600ms on conversational flows; some batch jobs ok at higher latencies.

Pricing / budget signals you mentioned on the call:
- Current vendor (OpenAI) run-rate: rough figure you gave today was $~10k/month, primarily for experimentation.
- Procurement note: headroom to justify additional spend if unit economics improve by >30% vs current host.

Two asks (can be quick bullets in reply):
1) Confirm expected steady-state month and peak month volumes (tokens/month). If you have a simple CSV (tokens by month) attach it and we’ll ingest.
2) Target $/1M tokens you’d consider a green light for a migration / dedicated contract. If you have tiered targets (pilot vs prod vs committed) include them.

What we’ll do next on our side:
- I’ll model three target unit-price scenarios (aggressive, mid, conservative) and show impact on monthly spend + approximate latency tradeoffs (quantization/batching choices).
- Share a short comparison vs OpenAI/Anthropic and an open-host average so you can compare apples-to-apples.

Attachments: I’ve attached a tiny tokens template (nimbus-cost-template.xlsx) you can fill if easier.

Thanks — if easier we can do a quick 20-minute price-qualification follow-up Thu/ Fri.

Best,
Rishi
VP, Solutions
Redwood Inference

---
From: Maya Patel <maya@nimbus.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-15T18:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo: cost sensitivity & target $/1M pricing check

Thanks Rishi — appreciated the concise recap. Quick answers inline.

Volumes: steady-state ~50M generated tokens/mo; Q4 push expected (product launch) where we can hit ~180–220M for 8–10 weeks. We also have a small nightly batch job that produces ~15M tokens/mo.

Targets/Budget: procurement gave a soft ceiling today of ~$6k/mo for the pilot (first 3 months), and ~ $18–22k/mo for full prod if unit costs don't move (i.e., our finance team will only approve expansion if we can show at least 25–35% unit cost savings over current host).

Target $/1M: we don’t have a hard cutoff but for committed prod we’d need to see something at or below $10/1M tokens to consider a multi-month reserved commitment. For pilots, up to $30/1M is tolerable given fast time-to-value, but pilot budget is limited.

Attached a filled version of your template (very rough). Also attaching sample traffic profile (monthly_tokens.csv).

If you can send the three scenario numbers by EOD tomorrow that would be super helpful; we’ll book a 20-min sync after that to walk procurement through it.

-Maya
Head of Product
Nimbus Analytics

Attachments: monthly_tokens.csv (csv), nimbus-cost-template.xlsx (filled)

---
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-16T09:05:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo: cost sensitivity & target $/1M pricing check

FWD of Maya's reply — key points for pricing model / quote:
- Steady-state 50M/mo, peak ~200M for launch window, plus 15M batch.
- Procurement: pilot budget ~ $6k/mo; prod budget $18–22k/mo but needs >=25% unit cost reduction vs current host.
- Target price for committed prod: <= $10 / 1M tokens (they said green-light threshold).

My asks to you both:
1) Monica — please run a quick rough cost calc for three pricing scenarios for Nimbus (pilot, committed-mid, committed-aggressive). Use conservative throughput assumptions and include options: quantized weights + 8-bit kernels; and a dedicated pool vs shared hosted. Deliverable: single-sheet CSV with columns: scenario, $/1M, est-monthly-cost, notes on perf tradeoffs.
2) Karthik — can you draft the margin/discount guidance for a 12-month reserved commit at the <= $10 target? Specifically, what discount band is feasible without eroding S&M payback beyond our target? Also call out any SLA/uptime constraints that would require higher tier.

Quick internal notes comparing public references (we'll formalize numbers):
- OpenAI baseline (their text-gen): ~ $18–25 / 1M tokens (depending on model, conversation vs assistant API).
- Anthropic baseline: ~ $16–22 / 1M tokens for comparable configs.
- Open-model hosts / infra-optimized vendors: often seen in the range $6–12 / 1M for large committed volumes + quantized execution.

Goal: produce a 1-page pricing slide + 1-sheet CSV with the three scenarios by EOD tomorrow so I can send to Maya ahead of the procurement call.

Thanks — R

---
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <maya@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-17T14:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo: cost sensitivity & target $/1M pricing check

Maya — thanks for the template and the traffic file. We’ve put together a quick, conservative set of scenarios and next steps (attaching the CSV + a short notes file). High-level callouts: 

- Pilot scenario (no commit, optimize for time-to-value): $/1M = $28 — estimate ~ $5.6k/mo for 50M tokens. Meets your pilot budget but price/unit is high, intended for immediate rollout.
- Committed-mid (12-month reserved, modest commit): $/1M = $12 — estimate ~ $600/mo after discounts? (sorry typo, corrected: estimate ~ $600 for infra line per 1M; total monthly ~ $600 * 50 = $30k — wait must be consistent)

Apologies — Monica flagged a quick calc error in the notes; final attached CSV has corrected monthly totals. Short answer: with a 12-month commit and modest discount we can get to ~$9–11 / 1M effective unit price depending on burst profile and whether they accept quantized model variants. That aligns with your <= $10 target in the aggressive reserved case.

Next steps:
- I’m happy to walk procurement through the numbers Wed 09/22 10:00 AM PT. Is that a good time?
- If they want to explore a pilot-to-reserve ladder, we can propose a 3-month pilot at ~$28/1M that transitions to a 12-month reserved at $9.5/1M if they hit a 100M commit threshold.

Attachments: redwood-rough-estimate.csv, pricing-comparison-notes.txt

If that schedule works I’ll send a short one-pager and a draft term sheet that calls out SLA and data residency options for Nimbus.

Best,
Rishi
VP, Solutions
Redwood Inference
